findings.description: A regular expression is compiled from a static string, not user input, posing no ReDoS risk.
findings.code_snippet:
NOT_REG_NAME = re.compile(
    r"""
        # any character not in the unreserved or sub-delims sets, plus %
        # (validated with the additional check for pct-encoded sequences below)
        [^a-z0-9\\-._~!$&'()*+,;=%]
    |
        # % only allowed if it is part of a pct-encoded
        # sequence of 2 hex digits.
        %(?![0-9a-f]{2})
    """,
    re.VERBOSE,
)

The pattern itself is safe and does not contain constructs that could lead to catastrophic backtracking. Therefore, this is a false positive.
